description.value: Bear's Den Pub is a pub within Manning Park Resort, set in the Cascade Mountains along Highway 3 — a key corridor for touring cyclists crossing southern BC. It sits alongside the Pinewoods Restaurant inside the resort complex and features pool tables, offering a relaxed spot to unwind after a long day in the saddle. The broader resort includes cabins, chalets, camping, and year-round outdoor activities, making this a natural extended rest stop on a multi-day route.
